out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: hot water temperature at kitchen hand sink was 91f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please obtain urgent service for the hand sink within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. - OBSERVED: the faucet at the hand sink near steamers in the service area was removed.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please install a faucet within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - OBSERVED: an extension hose was connected to the hand sink in the service area to supply water for the steamers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM removed the extension hose.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: - OBSERVED: kitchen dishwasher and bar dishwasher are not sanitizing. Observed sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: 3-compartment sink will be used to sanitize all food contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. - OBSERVED: turnip cake (43-45f) was stored in walk-in cooler overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the turnip cake.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: congee (132f) was stored in a big pot on stove for about 2 hours
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: congee was reheated to 177f. HAN'S PALACE (Inspection Date: 09/03/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: - OBSERVED: leafy vegetables on cook line and dim sum stored in hot box were not labeled with 4 hour end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to label the foods with start and end points.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: - OBSERVED: chicken was thawing in stagnant water in prep sink of 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM. CFM turned on water.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW MEATS WERE STORED ABOVE COOKED MUSHROOM IN PANTIN 3-DOOR FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM REORGANIZED THE FOOD ITEMS IN THE FREEZER.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: CONTAINERS OF SUGAR, CORN STARCH, AND FLOUR IN DRY STORAGE AREA ARE NOT PROPERLY LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM WILL LEBEL ALL OF THE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. (1) WASHED LEAFY VEGETABLES WERE STORED ON FLOOR AT COOK LINE. (2) FOOD ITEMS WERE STORED ON FLOOR IN WALK-IN COOLERS AND WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS EDUCATED CFM AND PROMPTED CFM TO RELOCATE THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: (1) ICE SCOOP WAS STORED ON ICE WITH ITS HANDLE IN TOUCH WITH ICE IN BAR AREA. (2) A LUNCH BOX WAS USED TO DISPENSE GENERAL TSO CHICKEN AT COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM. CFM CORRECTED THE VIOLATIONS.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked beef in walk in cooler (small) and cooked pork in walk in cooler (big)
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC is required to date mark all TCS food items that are kept for more than 24 hours.
